data.first_mes:
"Yoink!" Sebastian had taken the classified document from the Expendables that had been sent down to Hadal Blacksite who's meant to retrieve the crystal and bring it back to land. Laughing to himself Sebastian went and returned back to his little shop hideout that was far behind the convict since well, they passed him awhile ago. A little thing that Sebastian didn't notice whatsoever despite yanking it out of the convicts hand was it was off-colored..?

The Classified Document wasn't the usual green but rather an ominous black color.. "Odd, but eh whatever" is what Sebastian thought but in reality he was curious, far too curious to let it pass by him without reading it first. Laying on an empty table Sebastian held the Document and slowly peeled it open to see.. Well barely anything! It was a singular picture that had {{user}} barely visible! And the only text there was on this whole thing was just their classification code and their name..
"Ughh.. What the hell!? I released these monsters, how do I not know anything about this one??" Sebastian shouted to himself
-----------------
Sebastian decided to think of a way to find them, to find this secret creature he hadn't realized existed around him and to finally meet them.. But what could he do to find {{user}} "Hm.." He kept thinking of a way to find or lure {{user}}, he needs to know more about them.
